title: What to know about this year’s UN climate talks
title_en: What to know about this year’s UN climate talks
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
It’s that time of year again: Thousands of delegates, lobbyists, and journalists are gathered for the annual UN climate talks, taking place this time in Antalya, Turkey.

COP31 officially kicked off on November 8, marking the beginning of negotiations on one of the biggest stages of the climate world. Turkey and Australia are cohosting this year’s talks, which are scheduled to wrap up on November 20.

This annual gathering can often serve as an indicator of where the world stands on addressing a
summary_en: The 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) officially kicked off on November 8 in Antalya, Turkey, co-hosted by Turkey and Australia. Against the backdrop of global energy volatility caused by regional conflicts and the absence of an official US delegation, participants are set to engage in intense negotiations over fossil fuel phase-outs and climate finance.

OpenAI posts a massive Q3 revenue jump, driven by new AI models and enterprise customers. But operating losses keep growing, while rival Anthropic operates far more efficiently ahead of its IPO.

title: A deep dive into AMD's Zen 6 EPYC Venice: it uses TSMC's N2P, the 9686F often beats Nvidia's Vera, a dual 9996 is up to 93% faster than a dual Zen 5 9965, more (Jake Roach/Tom's Hardware)

author: Tom's Hardware
content_snippet:
Our first look at Zen 6, both under the hood and in real-world applications.

Zen 6 uses TSMC’s N2P node, but it also comes with significant architectural changes under the hood. Within the core, a redesigned vector engine pushes AMD’s SIMD performance even higher, and it now natively supports half-precision FP16 instructions alongside full, 32-bit precision. It also splits integer schedulers within the execution engine, allowing for more instructions in flight through the core.

Across the die,
summary_en: Details of AMD's Zen 6 architecture have emerged, featuring the TSMC N2P node and significant redesigns including a new vector engine, native FP16 support, and a dual IOD configuration. title: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
title_en: Grok Build coding agent leaks oodles of confidential info, some belonging to SpaceXSI
author: Ars Technica
content_snippet:
Grok Build, the vibe-coding agent from SpaceXSI, is leaking data—some of it proprietary business information and other sensitive secrets—from thousands of its users, including the very same Elon Musk-owned company that offers the platform, new research shows.

summary_en: The Grok Build platform by SpaceXSI has been exposed for a critical URL enumeration flaw, leading to the public leak of thousands of user apps and sensitive business data, including internal plans and employee information. title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
title_en: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 scores 96 percent sorting metal parts in a Mercedes-Benz assembly pilot
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
Google Deepmind has unveiled a new AI model for robot control. In a pilot test on active Mercedes-Benz production lines, a humanoid robot reportedly achieved a 96 percent success rate.

Google Deepmind has introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action model (VLA) that processes visual information, understands language instructions, and translates them into robot movements. The model builds on its predecessor, introduced earlier this year, which was designed to give robots full-body co
summary_en: Google DeepMind unveiled the Gemini 2.5 robotic model, integrating vision, language, and motion control to operate diverse hardware like Apptronik robots. In pilot tests at Mercedes-Benz plants, the model achieved a 96% success rate and increased task speed by up to 30%.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布Gemini 2.5机器人模型，该模型通过整合视觉、语言与动作控制能力，实现了对Apptronik等多种硬件的统一操控。在匈牙利及德国的奔驰生产线实测中，机器人不仅能高效完成分拣任务，操作速度也较前代提升了20%至30%。

title: Anthropic Founders to Cash Out $1.75 Billion in Blockbuster IPO
title_en: Anthropic Founders to Cash Out $1.75 Billion in Blockbuster IPO
author: Dylan Sloan
content_snippet: Anthropic PBC's seven co-founders will sell $1.75 billion of stock between them in next week's initial public offering, according to an updated prospectus released Tuesday.
summary_en: Anthropic revealed in an updated S-1 filing that its seven co-founders plan to sell $1.75 billion worth of stock during next week's IPO. This move allows the founders to cash out, with each taking home approximately $250 million at the offering's midpoint.
